rationale.reason: Complete electric poultry incubators/brooders fit 8436.21; generic heaters and independent parts are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Manufacture of complete electric poultry egg incubators, including setters and hatchers, and electric contact/radiant brooders. Define each model independently by heating method, circulation, turning, humidity provision and included control/supply assemblies. A forced-air automatic-turning incubator and a low-voltage contact brooder are distinct configurations; neither is assumed to contain the other’s parts. Brinsea examples support these distinctions, not a universal material recipe.

Exclude gas-fired brooders, general room/building heating and ventilation, egg handling unrelated to incubation, poultry feeding/watering machinery, separately sold parts, eggs/chicks, hatchery/brooding services, farm operation, biological hatchability/survival, growth, maintenance and end-of-life. No animal-output or heating-service reference is defined.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete electric poultry setters/hatchers and contact/radiant brooders, configured separately.
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Gas brooders, general heaters/fans, separately sold parts and animal-production services.
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New complete accepted appliance, dry and empty of eggs/chicks/test water; supplied detachable parts included; shipping packaging recorded separately.

Existing domestic fan/hood and non-electric fan-driven space-heater material records do not cover this dedicated poultry appliance. Exclude gas brooders, general building heating/ventilation, poultry keeping/feed/water equipment, separately sold parts and biological services. Narrower CPC context; classification acceptance separate. Old scaffold retained read-only and its identity not promoted.
evidence_limitations: Historical Brinsea model instructions support supplied-part and electric-heating architecture only; actual current BOM and foreground work/test instructions govern manufacturing.
No universal product mass, polymer grade, heater rating, lifetime, factory consumption, hatchability or brooding outcome is prescribed.
Inventory starting set requires completion against actual BOM, chemical and waste ledgers; unresolved identities and providers remain gaps.

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Search candidates do not verify discarded ABS trimming waste with the stated composition and mass reference.
Direct Stainless Steel has contradictory official Chinese non-alloy angle-section identity; generic Steel Sheet is carbon-steel with conflicting Chinese silver name, not this sheet.
Search plate candidates have conflicting material identities or pipe-mill-specific routes; no applicable carbon-plate identity verified.
Returned raw steel identities do not verify alloy-specific untreated stainless offcut waste.
Returned powder-waste identities have different location or reference-property restrictions; unrestricted polyester powder waste mass identity not verified.
Returned ovens, air-conditioning subassemblies and heater housings do not identify a finished poultry incubator enclosure.
Direct public Electric heating element uses Comparative Toxic Unit for ecosystems (CTUe) as its reference property, not Mass; reject this identity for the measured component kg exchange.
Electric heating element and whole space-heater categories do not identify the sealed complete low-voltage brooder panel.
Search and refined search returned a pneumatic conveying module containing blower/piping/filter, not an incubator circulation fan.
Wind-turbine gearboxes, handheld-tool motors and unspecified CN motor modules do not identify the complete egg-turning geared drive.
Returned polypropylene resin/recycling/waste or the entire incubator category cannot identify a finished egg tray.
English and Chinese controller searches returned unrelated elementary chemicals; no applicable assembled temperature-control board verified.
English and Chinese searches returned unrelated substances rather than a combined physical sensor module.
Search returned photovoltaic panels and rated distribution transformers, not the supplied mains-to-low-voltage brooder power unit.
Connectorized intermediate leads, 20-pin dishwashing ribbon proxies and winding wire do not establish the specified finished copper harness.
Returned mounting/support categories do not establish an adjustable brooder corner leg and its actual material.
Returned glass-fibre-reinforced plastic tank is not a finished polypropylene incubator pan; integral base channels must not be duplicated.
Returned CN sealing-element category does not specify silicone rubber or the door-gasket shape; supply geography and material are unresolved.
Returned aluminium bottle screw-cap closure is not a steel hexagon bolt.
Search returned Chemical Oxygen Demand, an oxygen-demand indicator rather than bulk humidification-test wastewater; resource or tap-water identities cannot stand for this waste liquid.
